title: Process diagram
role: A deliberate diagram explains a causal mechanism or relationship.
cropRules: Offer a linear text equivalent and preserve readable labels at narrow widths.
provenance: Original diagram or source/license; do not trace proprietary art.
delivery: Choose actual output dimensions and format from the display role.
Use responsive sources and avoid blocking the primary action on nonessential art.
Record bytes, dimensions, source and transformations in the project asset manifest.
